about.label: Palo Alto Networks
about.summary: American multinational cybersecurity company with headquarters in Santa Clara, California. The core product is a platform that includes advanced firewalls and cloud-based offerings that extend those firewalls to cover other aspects of security.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma pro kybernetickou bezpečnost, která vyrábí firewally a cloudovou ochranu sítí.

about.label: Palantir Technologies
about.summary: American publicly traded company that develops data integration and analytics software.
about.summary_cs: Americká softwarová firma, která dodává platformy pro analýzu dat a umělou inteligenci vládám, armádám i firmám.

about.label: CrowdStrike
about.summary: American cybersecurity technology company based in Austin, Texas. It provides endpoint security, threat intelligence, and cyberattack response services.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma pro kybernetickou bezpečnost, která chrání počítače a servery, sleduje hrozby a pomáhá řešit kybernetické útoky.

about.label: Microsoft
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Redmond, Washington. The company became influential in the rise of personal computers through software like Windows and has since expanded into areas such as Internet services, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, video gaming, and more.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, která vyrábí Windows a Office a provozuje cloud Azure.

about.label: Oracle Corporation
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Austin, Texas. Co-founded in Santa Clara, California, in 1977 by Bob Miner, Ed Oates, and current chairman of the board and chief technology officer Larry Ellison, Oracle is among the 50 largest companies in the world by market cap, and ranked 52nd on the Forbes Global 2000 as of 2026.
about.summary_cs: Americká softwarová firma, která dodává databáze, podnikový software a cloudové služby.

about.label: ServiceNow
about.summary: American software company that supplies cloud computing platforms for the creation and management of automated business workflows.
about.summary_cs: Americká softwarová firma, jejíž cloudová platforma automatizuje firemní procesy, třeba IT podporu nebo personalistiku.

about.label: Salesforce
about.summary: American enterprise software company headquartered in San Francisco, California.
about.summary_cs: Americká softwarová firma, největší dodavatel cloudového softwaru pro řízení vztahů se zákazníky (CRM).

about.label: Fortinet
about.summary: American cybersecurity company headquartered in Sunnyvale, California. It develops and sells security products including firewalls, endpoint security and intrusion detection systems.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma pro kybernetickou bezpečnost, která vyrábí firewally a další ochranu sítí a zařízení.

about.label: Cadence Design Systems
about.summary: American multinational technology and computational software company headquartered in San Jose, California.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která dodává software pro návrh čipů a elektroniky.

about.label: Adobe
about.summary: American multinational computer software company based in San Jose, California.
about.summary_cs: Americká softwarová firma, autor Photoshopu, Acrobatu a dalších nástrojů pro tvorbu a úpravu obsahu.

about.label: Datadog
about.summary: American company that provides an observability service for cloud-scale applications, providing monitoring of servers, databases, tools, and services, through a SaaS-based data analytics platform.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, jejíž cloudová platforma sleduje provoz serverů, databází a aplikací.

about.label: Strategy
about.summary: American company that provides business intelligence and mobile software.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která prodává analytický software, ale hlavně nakupuje a drží bitcoin – je jeho největším firemním vlastníkem.

about.label: Atlassian
about.summary: Multinational proprietary software company headquartered in Sydney, Australia, that specialises in collaboration tools designed primarily for software development and project management.
about.summary_cs: Australská softwarová firma, která vyrábí nástroje pro týmovou spolupráci a vývoj softwaru, například Jiru a Confluence.

about.label: Zscaler
about.summary: American cloud security company based in San Jose, California. The company offers cloud-based services to protect enterprise networks and data.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, jejíž cloudové služby chrání firemní sítě a data.

about.label: Nutanix
about.summary: American cloud computing company that sells software for datacenters and hybrid multi-cloud deployments.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která prodává software pro provoz datových center a hybridního cloudu.

about.label: Rubrik
about.summary: American cloud data management and data security company based in Palo Alto, California, founded in January 2014.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která dodává software pro zálohování a ochranu dat před ransomwarem.

about.label: Dynatrace
about.summary: American multinational technology company that provides an AI-powered observability platform.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma s platformou poháněnou AI, která sleduje výkon a stav aplikací a IT systémů.

holdings.name: CIRCLE INTERNET GROUP INC CLASS A

about.label: InterDigital
about.summary: American technology research and development company that provides wireless and video technologies for mobile devices, networks, and services worldwide.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která vyvíjí bezdrátové a video technologie a licencuje své patenty výrobcům mobilů a televizí.

about.label: SentinelOne
about.summary: American cybersecurity company listed on NYSE based in Mountain View, California. The company uses machine learning for monitoring personal computers, IoT devices, and cloud workloads.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma pro kybernetickou bezpečnost, která pomocí umělé inteligence chrání počítače, servery a cloud.

about.label: Qualys
about.summary: American technology firm based in Foster City, California, specializing in cloud security, compliance and related services.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která dodává cloudové nástroje pro kybernetickou bezpečnost a dodržování předpisů.
